title: Show my name and Public name
summary: Options › Account now lets you choose how you appear outside the game. Show my name hides your name on Credits and on the website's reviews. Public name changes the name Credits and the website show, while your in-game name stays the same.
highlights: Show my name: one switch for your name on Credits and website reviews
Public name: change the name Credits and the website show you as
Book Languages is now called Multi-lingual
